body:
The Vanguard is named in the earlier Gael record by adventurers describing their own responsibilities. In July 2024, Gartina speaks of “we in the Vanguard” and the sacrifice and consequence they have witnessed. In October, Scribonia identifies himself as having been part of it while describing the losses he has borne in the fight.

Duty beyond the next battle

In February 2025, Gartina again identifies herself as a member. She understands her duty as remaining at the forefront of the struggle against Death, yet chooses to stay where refugees and the new forest still need care. Her testimony keeps restoration within the company’s responsibilities rather than treating it as an interruption of the war.

The May 2026 battlefield report

The Babel-Ashur record describes Arjahn as part of a vanguard that is losing. That battlefield report remains important, but its lowercase wording alone does not establish whether it names this company, a forward formation or another body. Arjahn’s protective and rescue history is preserved in his own dossier.

A goal of cooperation

In the July 2026 Tower conversation, Severina says collaboration between the Veilguard and Vanguard is the goal. Her wording distinguishes them. The Veilguard’s separately recovered founding and leadership history does not establish a merger, identical roster or one uninterrupted command structure.

The open record

Gartina and Scribonia identify themselves with the company, adding evidence beyond the previously recovered battlefield reference. The founding date, charter, full roster, leadership, history of absences and exact relationship between the early company, the losing formation and later successor efforts remain incomplete.
